text:
Tara B: hit a publishguard failure while landing the new sample-sdk PR. regen-check flagged a tiny typegen diff and the CI matrix also showed an auth/retry flaky test in a different job. want to avoid a manual unblock if possible.

Evan C: can you paste the diff? ordering only or actual shape change?

Tara B: ordering-only, example from packages/sdk/src/types/gen.ts:
```diff
- export type Level = "low" | "med" | "high";
+ export type Level = "high" | "med" | "low";
```
But the downstream sample-app snapshot asserts the generated file string, so it failed.

Nadia S: snapshot fragility is the culprit. Tests should not depend on source text order. We should either normalize snapshots to compare parsed AST or make the generator deterministic.

Infra CI: regen-check job failed on runner: ubuntu-20.04-3, exit code 1, diff found in packages/sdk/src/types/gen.ts. publish-blocked: true

Evan C: separate note: the retry flake looked like a 401 that should have retried. On one runner the auth middleware didn't pick up AUTH_RETRY env var; on another it did. Possible test harness race where env is set after module load.

Tara B: my plan: quick fixes -> (1) update sample-app snapshots to parse JSON and compare keys/values (PR A) (2) add a small stable-sort postprocess in typegen generator and add a unit test that runs in CI (PR B) (3) fix test harness to set process.env before require() in integration tests (PR C).

Evan C: agree. For short-term release: allow manual override if PR A and PR C merged and a follow-up issue for PR B is opened. Long-term: enforce stable output and teach changelog bot to ignore order-only AST diffs.

Nadia S: I'll draft a changelog rule tweak: run a quick AST compare; if only property/union order changed, mark as patch. Could be added to changelog-gen pipeline.

Infra CI: publishflow guard: blocked -> awaiting human review. Related tickets: #4410 (typegen-order), #4411 (snapshot-fragile), #4412 (auth-env-race)

Tara B: opening the PRs now. ETA 90m. I'll ping #release when merged. Thanks! :pray:
